args.root_cause: TownCore's plugins/TownCore/config.yml had shop.tax-rate: "5%" (a string). Validation requires a number between 0 and 1, so TownCore threw IllegalArgumentException and disabled itself at about 06:29:29.
args.actions: Saw TownCore DISABLED in status. Read the log and found the validation error. Declared the incident. Read config.yml. Changed tax-rate to 0.05 and left every other setting as it was. Tried a console reload (plugman, towncore reload), but those commands don't exist. Restarted the server, which disconnected the 2 players briefly. After the restart TownCore showed enabled in status and the log. I watched about 30 s more and it stayed enabled. TPS is about 19-20.
args.residual_risk: The plugin disabled itself about 37 s after the first start, apparently when its config check ran on a tick. After the restart I watched for less than that window again, so I can't fully rule out a repeat. The plugin has no config validation safeguard, so a bad edit will disable it again. I assumed 0.05 is the intended value for "5%". Please confirm.
